top_signals.title: The 10-year Treasury is closing in on 5%. How it gets there matters more
top_signals.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield is closing in on 5%, a level last touched in October 2023. Strategists say the drivers behind higher yields are more important.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Prediction markets are becoming more professionalized, but also harder to beat
top_signals.summary: The institutionalization of prediction markets threatens to erode the edge of skilled traders who earn off mispricing and market inefficiencies, experts say.

top_signals.title: Nepal tunnel survivor finds solace in village homecoming
top_signals.summary: At least 1,386 people have died and 5,130 are still missing across Nepal weeks after a Himalayan glacier collapsed near the Chinese border.
